-- remove all spaces from rolenames because Entra IG does not support that --update businessrole set rolename = replace(rolename,' ',''); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plcCurrentStatus ( CatalogName TEXT, RoleName TEXT );
INSERT INTO plcCurrentStatus (CatalogName, RoleName) SELECT DISTINCT br.Name as CatalogName, br.rolename as RoleName FROM businessrole br WHERE br.rolename IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM plcCurrentStatus pcs WHERE pcs.CatalogName = br.Name AND pcs.RoleName = br.rolename );
